description: Search Geizhals, browse a hardware category, look up product ids/URLs, or list current price drops. Prices are EUR, cookieless, no proxy needed.

category.description: Hardware category used by categoryBrowse mode.
category.title: Category to browse

includePriceHistory.description: Add a price-history summary and change series to productDetails records (one extra request per product).
includePriceHistory.title: Include price history

includeSpecifications.description: Add the product specification table to each record when the source provides it.
includeSpecifications.title: Include specifications

keyword.description: Free-text product search (search mode) or a filter inside the chosen category (categoryBrowse mode). Not used by productDetails or deals.
keyword.title: Search keyword

manufacturer.description: Optional brand filter for search and categoryBrowse (e.g. ASUS, MSI, Samsung). A numeric Geizhals manufacturer id also works in search mode.
manufacturer.title: Manufacturer / brand

market.description: Country site and pricing market. Austria and Germany are fully supported.
market.title: Market

maxOffers.description: How many shop offers to include per product in productDetails mode (cheapest first).
maxOffers.title: Offers per product

maxPrice.description: Optional highest acceptable price. Used by search, categoryBrowse and deals.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (EUR)

minDiscountPercent.description: Deals mode: keep only price drops of at least this percentage.
minDiscountPercent.title: Minimum discount (%)

minPrice.description: Optional lowest acceptable price. Used by search and categoryBrowse.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (EUR)

mode.description: What to scrape: keyword search, category browse, product lookup, or current deals.
enumTitles: Look up product ids or URLs
Look up product ids or URLs (legacy alias)
mode.title: Mode

priceHistoryDays.description: Days of price history for productDetails when includePriceHistory is on.
priceHistoryDays.title: Price history window

productIds.description: Geizhals product ids (e.g. 3103639) or product page URLs (e.g. https://geizhals.de/...-a3103639.html). Used by productDetails mode.
productIds.title: Product ids or URLs

searchCategory.description: Restrict keyword search to one hardware category, or search the whole catalogue.
searchCategory.title: Search category

sort.description: Search and categoryBrowse sorting. Newest and best rated apply to categoryBrowse; search falls back to relevance.
sort.title: Sort order

title: Geizhals DACH Hardware Price Comparison Input
